page_title: VEN 1-1 VER | Venezia v Verona 27/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) launches a cross from the corner, but Lorenzo Montipo is alert to thwart the effort.
90+2' Jackson Tchatchoua latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) and heads towards goal.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Fali Cande (Venezia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gianluca Manganiello blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
87' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Alessio Zerbin is replaced by Franco Carboni (Venezia).
87' Substitution. Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) has come on for Joel Pohjanpalo.
86' Venezia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
85' The resulting corner from John Yeboah (Venezia) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
84' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Diego Coppola (Verona) sends a wild header high over the bar.
84' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
82' The game has come to an end for Amin Sarr. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
82' Tomas Suslov will be replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
80' Substitution. Gaetano Oristanio did his best and is replaced by John Yeboah (Venezia).
80' Here is a change. Issa Doumbia is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia).

80' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the bottom right corner, but Filip Stankovic has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
76' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Amin Sarr laid the ball off to Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
74' The corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is cleared away by the defence.
73' Verona are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
71' The corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is intercepted by Filip Stankovic.
71' Ball possession – 44:56.
68' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Mikael Egill Ellertsson and he is replaced by Francesco Zampano (Venezia).
67' A dangerous looking corner kick from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is cleared to safety by the defence.

67' Suat Serdar (Verona) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Filip Stankovic stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.
63' Here comes a substitution. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Domagoj Bradaric.
62' The expression of the referee Gianluca Manganiello is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is shown a yellow card.
61' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
61' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is about to take a corner kick.
61' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Verona.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.

58' Diego Coppola (Verona) outjumped the defenders to meet the ball from the free kick and plants a precise header from deep inside the box towards the net! The goalkeeper shows his reflexes and superbly keeps the ball out!
56' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Issa Doumbia, but Lorenzo Montipo displays great awareness to stop him.
54' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Verona earn a free kick.
51' It seemed like Tomas Suslov (Verona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
50' Diego Coppola (Verona) sends a long ball forward to Jackson Tchatchoua, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45+1' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
43' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
40' Casper Tengstedt is being substituted because of an injury. Paolo Zanetti sends Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) on the pitch.
38' Tomas Suslov (Verona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
38' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
36' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
34' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post.
32' Verona are ruled offside.
28' 1 - 0 Goal! Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
28' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
25' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
23' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
20' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
19' Tomas Suslov (Verona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
17' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Verona out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
14' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
11' Suat Serdar (Verona) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Filip Stankovic.
8' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
6' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Stankovic, who smothers the ball.
3' Amin Sarr (Verona) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
3' Suat Serdar (Verona) releases Amin Sarr, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Verona will take the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello is the one to supervise the game today.
